description: Lacrosse-only idea library for the LacrosseTube field room. Sport -> position -> ideas.

defense.title: Build the wall
defense.directive: Ball far away? Step in. Be the wall.
defense.why: From the help spot you can reach the dodge and still get back before the skip pass lands.
defense.viz: Backside defender steps off his man toward the crease, then recovers on the skip.

defense.title: Talk every exchange
defense.directive: Call ball, call help. Every play.
defense.why: Six silent defenders can chase the same attacker and leave another one wide open.
defense.viz: Two defenders run to one attacker; one attacker stands open until the calls fix it.

game.ask: Nobody talked. Tap the OPEN attacker.

defense.title: Slide on time
defense.directive: Teammate beat? Open the hips and go.
defense.why: Every tenth of a second you wait moves the meeting point closer to the cage.
defense.viz: Adjacent defender slides early and meets the dodger outside 8 yards.

defense.title: Take away the topside
defense.directive: Come out under control. Stand on his road.
defense.why: You only take away the cage when you stand on the line from him to the goal.
defense.viz: Defender breaks down on the line between the dodger and the cage.

game.ask: Tap where you take away his road to the cage.

defense.title: No switch without contact
defense.directive: No bump? Yell 'over' and stay with him.
defense.why: With no contact your path is still open. A switch makes two of you change jobs at once.
defense.viz: Defender fights over the pick and stays with the ball carrier.

defense.title: Recover on the skip
defense.directive: Skip pass in the air? Recover to your man.
defense.why: The ball is in the air long enough to close out if you go right away.
defense.viz: Help defender sprints back to his man while the skip pass travels.

game.ask: Tap the moment the skip pass leaves his stick.
game.right: You got back before the catch.
game.wrong: Late. He caught it and shot.

defense.title: Hunt every ground ball
defense.directive: Ball on the ground? Get there first.
defense.why: Every ground ball we lose gives them another try to score.
defense.viz: Chain of shrinking squares: each lost ground ball is one more try for them.
keys: put the ball on the ground

lsm.title: Win the ground ball
lsm.directive: Ball on the ground? Low hands, run through it.
lsm.why: Running through the ball with low hands wins it before the second player arrives.
lsm.viz: LSM runs through the ball with his stick low.

lsm.title: Win the wing
lsm.directive: Faceoff? Go on the whistle, not the ball.
lsm.why: Moving on the whistle gives you a full stride head start.
lsm.viz: Wing player breaks on the whistle and beats the other wing.

game.ask: Wing play. Tap the moment the whistle blows.
game.right: You beat their wing to it.
game.wrong: Too slow. Their wing got there first.

lsm.title: Trap on the sideline
lsm.directive: Ball near the sideline? Close the open side.
lsm.why: The sideline takes half his escape, and your stick takes most of the rest.
lsm.viz: Ball carrier pinned on the sideline by two defenders.

lsm.title: Be the hot slide
lsm.directive: You are hot? Go the moment he is beat.
lsm.why: The first slide decides the whole rotation.
lsm.viz: LSM slides from adjacent the moment the dodger turns the corner.

lsm.title: Hold in transition
lsm.directive: Outnumbered on the break? Hold. Wait for help.
lsm.why: Jumping the ball early lets them pass around you. Holding buys time for help.
lsm.viz: Three defenders hold a triangle until the trailer arrives.

lsm.title: Find the outlet
lsm.directive: Won the ball? Find the open man fast.
lsm.why: Right after a turnover one teammate is always open before the ride sets up.
lsm.viz: After the ground ball, one teammate stands open for the outlet.

game.ask: You won it. Tap the OPEN teammate.

midfield.title: Play to the whistle
midfield.directive: Ball loose? Keep running until the whistle.
midfield.why: A loose ball goes to whoever is still running when it stops rolling.
midfield.viz: One middie stops early; the one who keeps running wins the ball.

midfield.title: Hunt ground balls
midfield.directive: Ball on the ground? Get there first.
midfield.why: Every ground ball we win ends one of their tries to score.
midfield.viz: Shrinking squares show tries ending when we win the ball.

midfield.title: Hide the short stick
midfield.directive: Scramble? Swap so we all look the same.
midfield.why: If they cannot find the short stick, they can only guess: 1 in 6.
midfield.viz: Defenders shuffle so the short stick hides among the poles.

midfield.title: Slide from adjacent
midfield.directive: Open set? Adjacent slides. Go on time.
midfield.why: In an open set the closest teammate is the fastest help.
midfield.viz: Adjacent middie slides and the next man fills behind him.

midfield.title: Ride the clear
midfield.directive: Turnover? Ride hard. Force the bad pass.
midfield.why: A hard ride takes away the easy outlet, so the clear needs one more pass.
midfield.viz: Middie and attackman trap the clearing defender on the sideline.

game.ask: Ride the clear. Tap where the second rider goes.

midfield.title: Sprint back and match up
midfield.directive: Turnover? Sprint back. Find a man.
midfield.why: Matching up in the first 3 seconds stops the fast break.
midfield.viz: Middie sprints back while three defenders hold.

attack.title: Ride after every turnover
attack.directive: Turnover? Take away the goalie's first outlet.
attack.why: Taking away the first outlet makes the clear long and slow.
attack.viz: Attackmen pin the clearing defender against the sideline.

game.ask: Trap the clear. Tap where the second rider goes.

attack.title: Win ground balls up top
attack.directive: Loose ball on offense? Get there first.
attack.why: Every ground ball you win is another try for us and one less for them.
attack.viz: Attackman scoops a loose ball before the defender.

attack.title: Dodge to the bigger window
attack.directive: Dodge toward the middle, not the end line.
attack.why: Close and in the middle the cage looks huge. Wide and low it shrinks to nothing.
attack.viz: The shot window grows as the dodger moves to the middle.

game.ask: Tap the attacker with the biggest shot window.

attack.title: Find the open man
attack.directive: Doubled? Find the man nobody is guarding.
attack.why: Two defenders on you means one teammate is open.
attack.viz: Two defenders collapse on the ball; one attacker stands open.

game.ask: You drew a double. Tap the OPEN teammate.

attack.title: Make them commit
attack.directive: 4-on-3? Draw a defender, then move it.
attack.why: Every pass after a defender jumps leaves him a step behind.
attack.viz: A defender jumps the ball; two passes later the low man is open.

game.ask: Fast break. A defender jumps you.
game.right: He jumped, so someone is open. Move it.
game.wrong: He is on you. The open man had the shot.

attack.title: Ride to the whistle
attack.directive: Ball loose? Chase it until the whistle.
attack.why: The play is not over until the whistle. The player still running wins it.
attack.viz: Attackman keeps chasing the loose ball and wins it.

goalie.title: Direct the defense
goalie.directive: Call ball, call the slide, call the cutter.
goalie.why: You see the whole field, so your voice organizes six defenders.
goalie.viz: Goalie calls; each defender takes one attacker.

game.ask: Nobody heard you. Tap the OPEN attacker.

goalie.title: Own the arc
goalie.directive: Step out on the arc toward the shooter.
goalie.why: Stepping toward the shooter shrinks the cage he can see.
goalie.viz: Shot window shrinks as the goalie steps toward the shooter.

goalie.title: Outlet fast
goalie.directive: Save? Look up. Outlet in two seconds.
goalie.why: Before the ride sets up, the field has the most open space.
goalie.viz: Goalie saves and throws the outlet before riders get set.

game.ask: Tap the moment you make the save.
game.right: Fast outlet. The ride is not set yet.
game.wrong: Too slow. The ride is set.

goalie.title: Call the slide early
goalie.directive: Dodger beat his man? Call 'hot' now.
goalie.why: An early call gives your slide a head start.
goalie.viz: Goalie calls the slide the moment the dodger turns the corner.

goalie.title: Be set on the break
goalie.directive: Fast break? Set your feet. Play the shooter.
goalie.why: Set feet and a big body cover more cage than a guess.
goalie.viz: Goalie sets on the shooter while defenders hold.

game.ask: Fast break. The shooter winds up.
game.right: Set feet, big body. Make him beat you.
game.wrong: A guess opens half the cage.

goalie.title: Control the rebound
goalie.directive: Save it to your stick, not the crease.
goalie.why: A rebound in the crease is a free try for them.
goalie.viz: Goalie traps the shot instead of kicking it into the crease.
